content.passage: Remote medical consultations can improve access for people who live far from clinics or need routine follow-up. They are less suitable when a physical examination or urgent treatment is required. Health systems therefore use remote consultations as one option within a wider service rather than a complete replacement for face-to-face care.

answer.illustrative_response: Remote consultations can improve access and routine follow-up, but because some cases require physical examination or urgent care, they work best as part of a broader health service.
